title: Non-disclosure agreement; incident made classified
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: but then Jack Reed walked over and handed him this other piece of paper as he was putting mine down and it was uh an like a non-disclosure agreement

plain: In 1977 at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, a nuclear weapons guard named Mario Woods says he was debriefed after a UFO encounter he describes as an abduction, and that the incident was then made classified. He tells Michels that as he put his own paper down, Jack Reed, a captain in the Air Force Office of Special Investigations, handed another man "like a non-disclosure agreement", with a Colonel Spraker also named. If true, it would mean the Air Force had witnesses to a UFO event at a nuclear base sign away their silence.
